title: The Hubble Tension as Regime Mismatch: Background Gravity vs Structure Gravity in Energy-Flow Cosmology
abstract: Proposes that the Hubble tension is an environmental regime mismatch: early-universe background probes (CMB/BAO) measure G0, while late-universe distance-ladder probes inside collapsed structures measure Geff = G0 exp(aG·ΔΦ) > G0. Using the Friedmann scaling, the model predicts ln(Hstructure/Hbackground) = 0.5 aG ΔΦ, yielding a ratio 1.083 and H0,structure = 73.0 km/s/Mpc from H0,background = 67.4, without invoking a global time variation of G.
